title: Staking
description: Stake your favourite tokens to earn a share of protocol revenue
tvlTooltip: Total Value Locked (TVL) shows the current USD value of all assets deposited in this pool. It changes with deposits, withdrawals, and asset price movements.
aprTooltip: APR (30d) shows the estimated yearly reward rate based on the last 30 days of rewards. It changes as rewards, staking amounts, and asset prices move.
autoCompoundingTooltip: Share of the total staked supply that is set to auto-compounding mode. Auto-compounding means rewards are not paid out separately. They are automatically used to buy more of the staked asset and increase the staked balance over time.
yearlyRewardsPerTokenTooltip: Estimated yearly USD rewards for each token you stake. This is based on current reward rates and prices, so it can change over time.
chooseWhatToDoWithRewards: What do you want to do with your rewards?
chooseStakingType: How do you want to stake?
liquidStakingDescription: Rewards are auto-compounded to increase your staked balance.
accountStakingDescription: Earn {{symbol}} rewards. Claim or automate them your way.
unstakeInstantNotice: Please note that there is no unbonding time, unstaking will be instant.
unstakeInstantWithRewardsNotice: Please note that there is no unbonding time, unstaking will be instant and unclaimed rewards will be automatically claimed.
serviceFeeCaveat: A 5% service fee is charged on collected rewards when set to auto-compound.
stakersWithdrawalInfo: Stakers may withdraw their liquidity at any time. There is no lockup period.

getBrune.title: Get bRUNE
getBrune.descriptionBefore: To stake bRUNE, you first need to hold bRUNE in your wallet. You can buy bRUNE with RUNE on
getBrune.descriptionAfter: , then return here to stake it

stakingIntro: Stake {{bond}} in order to earn a share of rewards. Tokens can be staked to earn claimable {{reward}}, or set to auto-compound, buying and staking more {{bond}} with the {{reward}} rewards automatically.
stakingNoUnbonding: Please note that there is no unbonding time, and you can unstake instantly at any time.
stakingRevenueDescription: Rewards are collected from protocol revenue across all Rujira apps.
autoCompoundDescription: Rewards are automatically reinvested into your stake.
manualDescription: No automation. You claim rewards yourself whenever you want.
automateRewardsDescription: Rewards are claimed daily. You can optionally swap them before sending to your wallet.
sendAsSymbolSubtext: Rewards are sent directly to your wallet.
swapBeforeSendingSubtext: Rewards are swapped to your preferred token.
swapsExecutedHelper: Swaps are executed on RUJI Trade. Slippage applies.
telegramAlertsSubtext: Stay informed when rewards are claimed or swapped.
